hero.title:
Drone-Based Monitoring

for Oil Palm Disease

Detection
hero.description: DreamPalm integrates multispectral UAV imaging, backend NDVI image processing, and CNN with Random Forest models to detect Ganoderma-driven Basal Stem Rot at early stages — before visible symptoms appear.

about.title:
AI & IoT-powered monitoring

for oil palm plantations
about.description1: DreamPalm is a Next.js-based web dashboard platform integrated with IoT and Machine Learning. The system is designed to monitor, detect, and support the treatment of Basal Stem Rot (Ganoderma boninense) in real-time using drones.
about.description2: A Raspberry Pi-equipped drone flies over the plantation and streams WebRTC video and GPS telemetry to the backend server via 4G. All NDVI image processing and model inference — CNN as the primary model and Random Forest as the comparison model — are handled server-side to maintain hardware stability and detection accuracy.

research.imageCaption: DreamPalm UAV Platform · Raspberry Pi + Multispectral Camera
research.title:
IoT-based UAV with

backend AI processing
research.description: The DreamPalm drone runs Raspberry Pi connected to the backend server via 4G. WebRTC video and GPS telemetry are streamed in real-time to the server for processing: NDVI imaging for vegetation feature extraction, CNN as the primary detection model, and Random Forest as the comparison model.

specs.valSpray: Manual RC by Technician — guided by dashboard

classification.title: Live AI Video Feed
classification.body: Streams live footage from the drone camera overlaid with Machine Learning results — including bounding boxes and palm health status (Healthy, Mild, Moderate, Severe) based on NDVI analysis and the CNN model.

monitoring.title: Smart Spot Marking — Automatic Mapping
monitoring.body: A crucial feature where the system automatically records and marks GPS coordinates on a digital map at the exact moment AI detects a diseased tree. This helps Technicians track locations that need treatment and maintains a historical log of disease spots.

mapping.title: Historical Data & Monitoring
mapping.body: Displays statistics in numbers and charts showing counts of diseased, healthy, and treated palms. Farmers can view plantation history and track the health trend of their land over time.

specialFeature.title: Manual Spraying Guidance via RC
specialFeature.body: Since spraying must target the base stem (not sprayed from above the canopy), the web platform serves as an early warning system. Spraying is performed manually by a Technician using Remote Control, guided by the dashboard display. GPS location and action timestamp are automatically recorded for traceability.
